summary.text: Jim Grueneich is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 28 (home city listed as Ellendale), serving from 2017 to 2020 and since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Grueneich lists an occupation of Business Owner; Territory Manager.
It lists education as Alexandria Tech College.
It also lists US Air Force.
Family is listed as: Married (Naomi); 3 children; 3 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Grueneich's standing committee assignments as Transportation (vice chair) and Finance and Taxation.
